questions.question: Chef, Puppet, SaltStack va Ansible farqi: agent va push/pull modeli?
questions.explanation: Puppet va Chef — agent asosida, pull model (agent markaziy serverdan har 30 daqiqada konfiguratsiya oladi va qo'llaydi). Salt — agent (minion) + ZeroMQ event bus, push va tez parallel ijro. Ansible — agentsiz, SSH push.

questions.question: Puppet'da manifest, module, catalog, Hiera va Facter nima?
questions.explanation: Manifest (.pp) — resurslarning kerakli holati; module — manifest/template/fayllar paketi; Facter — node faktlari (OS, IP); Hiera — ma'lumotni koddan ajratish (muhit/rol bo'yicha qiymatlar); catalog — server faktlar asosida node uchun kompilyatsiya qilgan aniq holat, agent uni qo'llaydi.

questions.question: Chef'da cookbook, recipe, resource, run-list va Test Kitchen nima?
questions.explanation: Recipe — Ruby DSL'da resurslar; cookbook — recipe, template, attribute'lar to'plami; run-list — node'ga qaysi recipe/role qo'llanishi; chef-client agent Chef Server'dan olib qo'llaydi. Test Kitchen — cookbook'ni vaqtinchalik VM/container'da sinash (InSpec bilan tekshirish).

questions.question: SaltStack: master/minion, state, grain va pillar nima?
questions.explanation: Master buyruq yuboradi, minion'lar ZeroMQ orqali tinglaydi — minglab hostda soniyalarda ijro. State (.sls) — kerakli holat; grain — minion faktlari (OS, rol); pillar — master'dagi maxfiy/xos ma'lumot, faqat mos minion'ga beriladi.

questions.question: Puppet/Chef'dagi legacy flot'ni zamonaviy yondashuvga (Ansible, immutable image, K8s) qanday ko'chirasiz?
questions.explanation: Big-bang emas — strangler: avval inventarizatsiya (nima boshqariladi, kim egasi), yangi xizmatlar yangi usulda, eski node'lar bosqichma-bosqich. Immutable image (Packer + Ansible) bilan konfiguratsiya build vaqtiga ko'chadi, runtime agent kerak bo'lmaydi.
